scripts.prepare: pnpm build:core && if [ -z "$CI" ] && [ -e .git ]; then lefthook install || echo 'warning: lefthook install failed; run: pnpm exec lefthook install' >&2; fi
scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,server,client -c yellow,blue,green "pnpm --filter @sweep/core dev" "pnpm --filter @sweep/server dev" "pnpm --filter @sweep/client start"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:core && tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm build:core && pnpm -r test && pnpm test:repo
